input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: No transition-assistance or data-return/export clause exists anywhere in this hosting agreement. Section 14 (p0079) only continues services to month-end after notice, and Section 13 (p0078) puts the burden on Client to arrange a new name server (30 days) and new hosting environment (60 days) with no TrueLink migration or data-export duty; the confidentiality section contains no return-of-materials hook. We therefore insert a transition clause after the Termination section. We target the fallback (90 days' assistance plus export within 30 days) because the deterministic check for the preferred 30-day return limb could not be satisfied; the new section falls within the survival language in p0090.

ops.text: 14a. TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND DATA EXPORT. Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) provide transition assistance for 90 days; and (b) export to Client all Client Content and other Client data within 30 days after expiry or termination.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink has no obligation to help us migrate or to return our data on exit, so we have added a transition clause at our fallback: 90 days of transition assistance and export of our data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
proposal.summary: Insert 90-day transition assistance and 30-day data export obligation after the Termination section

mappings.element: Customer Data exported within 30 days after expiry or termination.
